preparationCases.title: Teammate handoff into product reveal
preparationCases.scriptText: Thank you, Sam. That problem is exactly why we spent eighteen months rebuilding our field recorder from the ground up. Today we are introducing Lumera.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: And now Maya will show you what we built to solve that.
preparationCases.notes: Two-speaker handoff into a reveal line.

preparationCases.title: Solo act transition from story to demo
preparationCases.scriptText: That is the latency bottleneck on paper. Now let us leave the slides behind and watch PulseDeck sync a live timeline in front of you.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: Now let us leave the slides behind and watch PulseDeck sync a live timeline in front of you.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Every extra second of cloud lag breaks the presenter's rhythm.
preparationCases.notes: Solo presenter shifting from framing into a live demonstration.

preparationCases.title: Reclaiming stage after teammate demo
preparationCases.scriptText: Thanks, Jordan. As you just saw in Jordan's walkthrough, none of those edits required a network connection. That same local engine powers every team workspace.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: With that saved offline, I will hand it back to Alex.
preparationCases.notes: Echoing the teammate's closing theme before advancing.

preparationCases.title: Opening handoff after moderator cue
preparationCases.scriptText: Good morning everyone. Two years ago our engineers started asking why offline tools still felt like second-class software.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Please welcome the HarborSync product team to the stage.
preparationCases.notes: Taking a deliberate pause after the introduction cue.

preparationCases.title: Short handoff into Q&A partner
preparationCases.scriptText: To walk through how our local index stays under fifty megabytes, I am thrilled to invite Priya onto the stage.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: I am thrilled to invite Priya onto the stage.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: That keeps every transcript private on the handset.
preparationCases.notes: Named speaker introduction with clean landing.

preparationCases.title: Three-part setup resolving into one product
preparationCases.scriptText: Today we are bringing three tools together. A pocket audio studio. A private local transcriber. And a rehearsal notebook that works on a plane. These are not three separate apps. This is one workspace, and we call it VeloNotes.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: This is one workspace, and we call it VeloNotes.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Every speaker carries too many disconnected tools onto the stage.
preparationCases.notes: Classic repeated triad resolving into a short product reveal.

preparationCases.title: Problem contrast into short headline
preparationCases.scriptText: Most rehearsal apps ask you to upload raw drafts to a cloud server and wait. We refused that tradeoff. Lumera runs completely offline on your phone.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: Lumera runs completely offline on your phone.
preparationCases.notes: Short problem contrast setting up a crisp headline.

preparationCases.title: Question and contrast before revealing gesture
preparationCases.scriptText: How do you mark a stumble mid-sentence? A tiny Bluetooth remote? No. You drop it, you lose it, and the battery dies. Instead, one thumb tap on the screen drops a measured marker.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: one thumb tap on the screen drops a measured marker.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Live rehearsals break down whenever you fumble with hardware.
preparationCases.notes: Question-and-contrast setup rejecting the old way before the reveal.

preparationCases.title: Pricing anchor reveal without exact phrase marked
preparationCases.scriptText: Teams normally pay ninety dollars a month for studio transcription and another forty for cue software. We wanted every independent speaker to own it outright. Starting next Tuesday, HarborSync is forty-nine dollars once, with no subscription.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: That brings us to when you can put this in your pocket.
preparationCases.notes: Anchoring familiar numbers before landing the single price reveal.

preparationCases.title: Minimal reveal title card
preparationCases.scriptText: Meet PulseDeck Air. Half the weight, twice the battery, ready for the road.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Now let us open the box.
preparationCases.notes: Very short reveal passage with exact phrase.

preparationCases.title: Live tap and scroll walkthrough
preparationCases.scriptText: Watch the bottom of the screen here. I tap Record once, deliver my opening line, and tap Stop. The audio waveform appears right away, ready for replay.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: Watch the bottom of the screen here.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Let me show you how fast a single take feels.
preparationCases.notes: Directing attention to a visible on-screen action during demo.

preparationCases.title: Demo with deliberate loading silence
preparationCases.scriptText: I select our ten-page draft from Files and tap Import. [pause while file loads on projector] There it is — every section split cleanly with speaker badges intact.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: There it is — every section split cleanly with speaker badges intact.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: You do not have to retype anything you already wrote.
preparationCases.notes: Demo containing an intentional stage direction pause while loading.

preparationCases.title: Question then visible gesture demo
preparationCases.scriptText: How do you replay the exact pause before your reveal? You tap the timestamp pill right here, and playback jumps half a second ahead so you hear the lead-in.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Finding one shaky transition in a ten-minute file usually wastes half your rehearsal.
preparationCases.notes: Asking a quick question then demonstrating the tap.

preparationCases.title: Multi-step screen anchor demo
preparationCases.scriptText: Look at the top bar where it says Cue Words. I switch to Memory mode, hide the script, and keep only the teammate's final line at the top.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: Look at the top bar where it says Cue Words.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Once the words feel familiar, you want training wheels off.
preparationCases.notes: Anchoring audience gaze to a specific UI location.

preparationCases.title: Airplane mode proof demo
preparationCases.scriptText: Let me swipe down Control Center and turn on Airplane Mode right now. Notice the orange airplane icon in the corner. I tap Record, speak two lines, and stop — playback still works instantly.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: Notice the orange airplane icon in the corner.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Conference Wi-Fi always fails at the worst minute.
preparationCases.notes: Pointing to visual proof on screen during a live check.

preparationCases.title: Opening callback into final close
preparationCases.scriptText: Two years ago we asked why offline rehearsal felt neglected. Today you saw Lumera import a two-speaker talk, capture a clean take in Airplane Mode, and pinpoint a single pause. Great delivery is built one take at a time. Thank you very much.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: Great delivery is built one take at a time.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: That is everything shipping in version one.
preparationCases.notes: Echoing the opening question before landing the final takeaway.

preparationCases.title: Lineup identity closing statement
preparationCases.scriptText: Today we brought together scripting, offline recording, and evidence-based playback in one iPhone app. No servers, no scores, just your voice and your judgment. Thank you for joining us.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: No servers, no scores, just your voice and your judgment.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: And that completes our tour of HarborSync.
preparationCases.notes: Synthesizing the whole presentation into one clear identity line.

preparationCases.title: Short memorable final line
preparationCases.scriptText: Rehearse the transition you care about most, listen back honestly, and walk onto stage calm. Thank you.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Before we open the floor for questions, one last thought.
preparationCases.notes: Landing on a brief closing line and stopping cleanly.

preparationCases.title: Team gratitude close after joint demo
preparationCases.scriptText: None of this ships without the engineers, designers, and beta presenters who tested early drafts in hotel rooms before big talks. From all of us at VeloNotes, thank you.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: From all of us at VeloNotes, thank you.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Thanks again, Priya — that metric makes the difference clear.
preparationCases.notes: Closing after returning from a teammate's segment.

preparationCases.title: Minimal thank-you sign-off
preparationCases.scriptText: Thank you very much for your time today.
preparationCases.exactPhrase: Thank you very much for your time today.
preparationCases.handoffCueText: Our beta link is live right now.
preparationCases.notes: Very brief sign-off where keeping delivery simple or abstaining is reasonable.
